description: The renderer recomputes measured ratios with floating-point Math.round, so a valid safe-integer FINANCIAL API model produced by the integer-safe core is rejected as invalid score payload. With gross=9007199253740991 and net=945755921642804, the core returns value=10 but the renderer computes 11 and turns the score section into a load error.

evidence.testName: fresh Node reproduction: computePanelScores returned value=10 for numerator=945755921642804 denominator=9007199253740991; renderScoreCards then threw invalid score payload because UI Math.round returned 11
